title: A new Evia update is ready
details: Carpentry & Joinery ST0264 v1.4 now migrates into one Nisi course pack containing both Site Carpenter and Architectural Joiner pathways

The migration verifies 6 categories, 42 jobs, 135 evidence points and 57 KSBs for Site Carpenter, plus 6 categories, 47 jobs, 148 evidence points and 57 KSBs for Architectural Joiner before installing
Existing ST0264 evidence, RPL, OTJ, EPA and target data keep their current pathway-specific storage, and the built-in course remains available as a fail-safe until the live pack test is confirmed
